business_problem: Hallam builds custom no-code agents with Gemini Enterprise, removing development bottlenecks and scaling customer insights. For digital marketing agencies, capturing client attention is harder than ever. Online platforms are crowded with content, while customer acquisition costs have increased significantly as large numbers of businesses chase a small pool of active buyers.
solution_summary: Grounding these assistants in real company data keeps them accurate and relevant. Using secure data connectors, Hallam links Gemini Enterprise directly to internal repositories like Google Drive , HubSpot, and Slack to provide rich context across channels. New team members can use a grounded agent to get up to speed quickly on internal policies and processes instead of reading through millions of files. As a result, weeks’ worth of onboarding sessions can now be delivered within the first 2-3 days of onboarding. Account managers, meanwhile, can use a grounded agent to rapidly pull historical communication timelines and performance files to prepare reports on the success of client marketing campaigns. With , Hallam transitioned scattered, individual AI initiatives into a powerful agentic taskforce where custom automation tools can be safely explored and curated by any user.
